name: Wellington
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Wellington, CO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Wellington, Colorado for 2026: Santa, carriage rides, a petting zoo and a free book, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Wellington does Christmas as a small town series called Home for the Holidays, run by the Town with the Wellington Main Street Program. Families get Santa, horse and carriage rides and holiday lights, all within a few blocks of downtown.
celebrates: Wellington keeps its holiday season close to home. The Town of Wellington and the Wellington Main Street Program bundle the month into a Home for the Holidays series that starts the Saturday after Thanksgiving with Shop Small Saturday and runs through a December Mingle on Main downtown. In between, Winter Wonderland fills Centennial Park with holiday lights, face painting and horse and carriage rides, and Santa arrives courtesy of the Wellington Fire Protection District. The library takes the next turn with Holiday Magic at Owl Canyon Coffee, where kids get a free book and a free ornament. Xcel Energy sponsors Winter Wonderland.
lastyear: Last season Wellington held its Community Christmas Parade on December 13, 2025 at 5:15 pm, and the Town's announcement gave the theme as Tacky, Cozy and Bright. The same post opened by noting that construction kept the Town from hosting its Parade of Lights and Winter Wonderland in their usual form that year. The Cleveland Avenue construction project has since finished, and the Town has posted a three dimensional animated fly-through of the completed street. This year the series is back in Centennial Park and at Owl Canyon Coffee.
facts: Wellington was named for Charles L. Wellington, traffic manager of the Colorado and Southern Railway, when the railway planned its line north of Fort Collins in 1902. The town plat was filed with Larimer County in January 1903, and the town was incorporated in 1905 and elected its first mayor that year. Cleveland Avenue was the main route in and out of town, and the other east to west streets were named for presidents, including Garfield, Harrison, McKinley and Roosevelt. Owl Canyon Coffee sits in a building from 1905.
trains: Wellington owes its start to a train. The Colorado and Southern Railway finished its line in October 1903, and the first train carried sugar beets from Boxelder Valley farms to the sugar factory in Fort Collins. The depot stood at the west end of the original town. Wellington has no Christmas train ride of its own on our list this year. For a model railroad visit, the Colorado Model Railroad Museum in Greeley has a 5,500 square foot HO layout with 72 scale miles of track.

traditions: The Town of Wellington opens its Home for the Holidays series with a petting zoo, carriage rides and local shopping around Centennial Park.
Santa arrives at Centennial Park, courtesy of the Wellington Fire Protection District, with holiday lights, face painting and horse and carriage rides.
Wellington Public Library sponsors this annual morning at Owl Canyon Coffee with Santa, a free book and a free ornament.
The Wellington Main Street Program holds Mingle on Main on the third Friday of each month, and the December edition is part of Home for the Holidays.
The Town held a Community Christmas Parade in December 2025 with the theme Tacky, Cozy and Bright, so ask the Town whether it returns.
kidfact: Wellington is named after a railroad worker named Charles L. Wellington, and the first train to roll into town in 1903 carried sugar beets.
faq: The Town of Wellington and the Wellington Main Street Program run a Home for the Holidays series with Shop Small Saturday, Winter Wonderland at Centennial Park, Holiday Magic at Owl Canyon Coffee and a December Mingle on Main downtown. Santa appears at two of them, and there are horse and carriage rides.
Where can kids meet Santa in Wellington?

The Town's release names two chances. At Winter Wonderland in Centennial Park, Santa arrives courtesy of the Wellington Fire Protection District. At Holiday Magic, sponsored by Wellington Public Library, kids see Santa again at Owl Canyon Coffee at 3745 W. Cleveland Avenue while picking up a free book and ornament.
Who runs the Home for the Holidays events?

The Town of Wellington runs the series with the Wellington Main Street Program. Xcel Energy sponsors Winter Wonderland and Wellington Public Library sponsors Holiday Magic. Questions go to Events@WellingtonColorado.gov, and accommodation requests go to ADA@WellingtonColorado.gov or 970-568-3381, as the Town's news release directs.
Why is the town called Wellington?

It is named for Charles L. Wellington, traffic manager of the Colorado and Southern Railway in 1902, when the railway planned its route north of Fort Collins. The town plat was filed in January 1903, and the first train carried sugar beets from local farms to the Fort Collins sugar factory that October.

It is a monthly community gathering organized by the Wellington Main Street Program, held on the third Friday of the month in downtown Wellington. It was created to connect the community, according to the Main Street Program, and the Town lists a December edition as part of its holiday series.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Wellington for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from Shop Small Saturday at Centennial Park (November 28) through Holiday Magic at Owl Canyon Coffee (December 12), with Winter Wonderland and Santa's arrival at Centennial Park (December 5) in between. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Wellington

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Wellington
  • 1 free event: Winter Wonderland at Centennial Park
  • Meet Santa: Winter Wonderland (December 5) and Holiday Magic at Owl Canyon Coffee (December 12)
  • Rides and animals: horse and carriage rides at Winter Wonderland and Shop Small Saturday, plus a petting zoo (November 28)
  • Free book and free ornament for kids at Holiday Magic (December 12)
  • Season: November 28 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Wellington families also use our guide to Fort Collins Christmas events for kids, which covers Garden of Lights and NoCo Winter Wonderland and more.
